name: Dumbbell Clean and Press
instructions: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, then hinge at the hips and lower them to just below your knees.
Drive your hips forward and shrug, pulling the dumbbells up to your shoulders.
Press them overhead until your arms are locked out.
Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders and then to your sides, and repeat.
image_prompt_scene: Standing with the dumbbells at the sides, about to hinge at the hips.
